notes: NEW distinct data-acquisition lead, not a material outcome cohort. Forever Stats 0.63.0 changelog dated Oct 30 2026 names Retail plus Forever game versions 12.1.7/1.60.1, counts disenchanting/prospecting/milling as gathering and adds Professions tab export. This does NOT establish retained original input-itemLinks, actual ilvl+bonuses, skill/specialization, per-cast output rows, zero-output operations, refund ledger or existence of a public exported player data set. Independently Ka0s Loot History labels processed loot provenance 'Disenchant / Milling / Prospecting' as Certain/Inferred, but does not prove a completed-operation denominator and lists older Retail 12.0.7. The Golden Data full-export feature is primarily generic gathering and loot. Rechecked 2026 source searches and found no distinct zero-inclusive 12.1.5 cohort; earlier Cardinalai, Honeybone, PocketCFO 15-profile 57-output study, existing 272246 Wowhead 140-count item-side table, and weekly KP reports must NOT be copied or promoted as new independent records. No P(hit), zeros, yield quantities, prices or confidence inferred. Next original-data route is consenting player-provided Retail export with complete operation/event context; ask Master for a capture/export schema if necessary.
